category_title: Fourth-grade student with severe disabilities exhibiting physical aggression and escape behaviors
scenario_title: Sensory overload leading to escape attempts and classroom disruption
minimal_context: Joseph is expected to sit at his desk and participate in a reading activity while his classmates are present in the room.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Joseph, let's get started on our reading activity. Please sit at your desk and look at the book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Squeezes his fidget toy tightly, looking around the classroom and covering his ears) Too loud... I can't.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to focus on the reading activity with the rest of the class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws the fidget toy on the floor, beginning to yell as his frustration grows) No! Too much!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Joseph, please lower your voice and stay in your seat.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Screams loudly, pushes away from the desk, and runs toward the classroom door to escape, urinating on the floor as he tries to leave the room)
